name: The Night Watch
summary: In Darkshire, The Night Watch holds the line against the dead rising nearby. Stormwind has withdrawn its garrison, leaving the town’s local militia to rely on travelers at Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

sections.title: Abandoned by the Crown
sections.body: Stormwind once guarded Duskwood, but its royal resources dwindled as political discord took hold in the capital. Then the crown withdrew its commissioned soldiers, leaving Darkshire with little defense against the forest’s encroaching shadows. The people formed a local militia called the Night Watch, led by Commander Althea Ebonlocke. It stands between the cursed forest and the town’s remaining residents.

sections.title: Clearing the Tranquil Gardens
sections.body: South of Darkshire, Tranquil Gardens Cemetery was once a peaceful resting place. Now restless skeletons and reanimated spellcasters roam its graves. The Night Watch is stretched thin along Duskwood’s borders, so Commander Ebonlocke sends arriving travelers to strike down Skeletal Warriors and Skeletal Mages before the dead reach the roads.

faq.q: Why does the Night Watch need outside help?
faq.answer: Stormwind recalled its commissioned garrison from Duskwood, leaving Darkshire to defend itself. The Night Watch is a local militia with too few people and supplies to fight the undead across the territory alone.

Althea Ebonlocke is a relative of Darkshire’s mayor, Lord Ello Ebonlocke, and commands the Night Watch. She organizes the town’s defenses and rallies those able to stand against Duskwood’s dark menaces.

faq.q: Where is the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery?
faq.answer: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery lies just south of Darkshire. It remains an active burial site, but dark magic in Duskwood has raised the dead, who now harass travelers near the town’s edge.

faq.q: What creatures are rising in the Tranquil Gardens?
faq.answer: Skeletal Warriors and Skeletal Mages overrun the cemetery. These animated remains retain martial skill and arcane power, making them a deadly threat to ordinary townsfolk.

faq.q: Does this assignment end the threat at the cemetery?
faq.answer: No. Clearing skeletons from Tranquil Gardens is only the first effort. The Night Watch faces growing threats deeper in the woods, and further expeditions are needed to manage Duskwood’s worsening corruption.

angles.text: For Alliance loyalists, this duty shows Stormwind’s neglect. Frontier citizens must fight for their own survival without royal aid.
As a paladin, you face an affront to the Light at Tranquil Gardens. Desecrated graves call for consecrated steel and righteous judgment.
As a priest, you can lay tormented, restless skeletons to rest as an act of spiritual mercy in a land under sinister curses.
